You logged in on a new device. Because of End-to-End encryption, your chat history is not available here.

Link this device from your old device (Settings → Active Connections → Link a device) to get a fresh identity, or restore your full history from a .nyxbak backup file.

link.entry_desc: Scan the QR from your signed-in device
